author: Nancy Fielding
text: Well that needle doesn’t stay in your arm there is a thin flexible cannula on the sensor that takes the reading .  Typically that needle retracts into the applicator after the insertion process.  The sensor getting stuck in the applicator is not normal .  Give it its warm up hour to see if it starts giving readings .  If it doesn’t work call customer service for a free replacement .
